hypothesis: The unchanged exposure-filter heuristic trained on all176 N12 queen-plus-camel patterns is noninferior to the supplied N13 queen-plus-camel oracle within0.1percentage points in certificate-first N20 accuracy, with zero wrong stopped chains.
antecedent: H3r recovered the superqueen target graph. This tests the same rule on queens plus camel attacks (1,3)/(3,1), without tuning to new-family exposures or target outcomes.

exposure.expected_count: For each source offset o, E_o=N*sum(p_i*p_j) over valid N12 placements with displacement o; p_i=m_i/N, N=176 unique source patterns. Equivalently sum(m_i*m_j)/N.
exposure.finite_rule: Retain an observed-zero finite offset iff E_o>=natural_log(K/0.01). No additional condition. All originally inferred homogeneous lines remain unchanged.
exposure.interpretation: Independent-cell-occupancy exposure heuristic only. The constrained source solutions do not satisfy that independence model. No calibrated p-values, multiple-testing guarantee, confidence coverage or Bonferroni validity is claimed.

line_family: Enumerate integer(a,b) in[-2,2]^2 except(0,0), gcd(abs(a),abs(b))=1, canonical sign(first nonzero positive). A line is a*dr+b*dc=0. Retain iff it contains>=3 zero-count offsets in that arms source domain and0 positive-count offsets. Retain all qualifying lines; no target selection.
construction: Use the same source marginal-exposure heuristic E>=ln(K/.01), unfiltered homogeneous-line inference and hybrid union. Control retains every source zero. Full176 unique N12 source patterns; no radius cutoff or target-label tuning. Target J=13*forbidden-1, diagonal/unary0. Oracle explicitly supplies N13 queen+camel attacks; knight attacks are not part of this task.

calibration.explanation: Supplied target q13 and symbolic delta=q-1,tau=-q(q-1)/2; inherited N12 unit unchanged, no camel-target calibration.

search.stop: strict local margin plus q-cardinality gate

decision: Support if exact one-sided95% upper probability of any paired-seed accuracy regression within an input<=0.001 and zero filtered-arm wrong stopped chains. Falsify if paired-input bootstrap one-sided95% upper filtered-minus-oracle accuracy difference<-0.1pp OR any filtered wrong stop; otherwise inconclusive.2000bootstrap draws,RNG20261114,all3searchseeds clustered within input. Filtered-versus-unfiltered comparison and coverage descriptive.
diagnostics: After frozen-source fitting audit every exposure/retention, true and false camel-family graph edges, exact identities, exhaustive camel-family membership/givens, all margins and valid-certificate capacity. No target diagnostic changes the model.
identity: Deduplicate only exact S,B,q,delta,tau,unit equality, before target search, keeping all four logical arms and explicit matched-seed mappings. First arm in frozen order is representative.

dataset.transfer: N12 to N13 upward transfer under unchanged exposure heuristic on a new attack family.
dataset.target_distribution: Uniform unique valid1/2/3clue queen-plus-camel N13 inputs excluding all H3j/H3k/H3l/H3m/H3n search input keys.

limits: Fixed independent-cell exposure heuristic; no calibrated p-values, multiple-testing or coverage guarantee for constrained solutions.
New attack family but same geometric/displacement/line/cardinality priors; not arbitrary-rule learning.
One complete unique-pattern source universe; repeated search seeds are not independent source draws.
N12toN13 changes target cardinality symbolically; unit/temperature/margin/chain and move budgets remain inherited.
